name: jala-agent-plugins
description: JALA plugins for Figma design and Google Workspace workflows.

plugins.name: 9router-jala
plugins.description: Use a configured 9Router gateway for JALA chat, images, audio, embeddings, web search, and web fetch workflows.

plugins.name: crisp-jala
plugins.description: Operate JALA Crisp conversations, messages, people profiles, and workspace data through REST API skills.

plugins.name: figma-ui
plugins.description: Create and refine Figma screens, components, diagrams, and prototypes.

plugins.name: gog
plugins.description: Search and manage Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and more.

plugins.name: mattermost-jala
plugins.description: Search Mattermost, read channel threads, create channels, and post in JALA.

plugins.name: odoo-jala-web
plugins.description: Automate personal Odoo JALA browser tasks and turn taught workflows into reusable personal skills.

plugins.name: odoo-jala-xmlrpc
plugins.description: Read JALA Odoo records and discover schemas through a read-only XML-RPC client and workflow guidance.

plugins.name: scheduler
plugins.description: Schedule prompts in existing ChatGPT/Codex desktop and Claude sessions with capability-aware setup.
